headline: TNPL announces cessation of Non-Executive Director N Venkatesh
hook: Leadership change at Tamil Nadu Newsprint
summary: Tamil Nadu Newsprint & Papers Limited informed the exchange that Thiru N Venkatesh, I.A.S, has ceased to be a Non-Executive Director of the company with effect from October 22, 2026. This routine board-level change involves a government nominee stepping down from his non-executive position. Indian retail investors should note that administrative board transitions of this nature typically have a neutral impact on day-to-day operations and stock performance.
why_it_matters: Routine board exit with no direct impact on share price

headline: TNPL appoints V Arun Roy as Non-Executive Director
hook: Bureaucratic board change at paper maker
summary: Tamil Nadu Newsprint & Papers Limited has announced the appointment of Thiru V Arun Roy, I.A.S., as a Non-Executive Director on its board, effective October 22, 2026. Board shuffles involving administrative officials are routine for state-backed enterprises in India. Retail investors in TNPL should note administrative changes at the helm, though such appointments rarely trigger immediate stock volatility.
why_it_matters: Routine board reshuffle has no immediate impact on share price
